1.consolidated_definition: “Buey amarillo y oscuro, o sea, berrendo.” “De dos colores.” “La ojera de la parte frontal negra con manchas regadas por todo el cuerpo y alguna parte amarilla”. Cuando los obreros iba a cobrar su jornal decían: “Vamos a cobrar el buey johco” o sea, una cuenta no muy clara.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Yellow and dark ox, or rather, dappled. "Of two colors." The eye patch on the black frontal area with scattered spots throughout the body and some yellow part.

When workers went to collect their wages, they would say: "Let's collect the Johco ox," meaning a somewhat unclear account.
